target_framework: React (JavaScript) + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + Lucide Icons + Radix/Shadcn UI

responsive_layout_strategy.desktop: Centered chat container with max-width ~600px to 680px (max-w-2xl), centered horizontally (mx-auto), shadow-2xl, border border-slate-200/80, background canvas bg-slate-100/70, viewport height min-h-screen flex flex-col
responsive_layout_strategy.mobile: Full width layout (w-full max-w-full px-0), mobile app viewport feel with h-[100dvh] flex flex-col
responsive_layout_strategy.breakpoints: Responsive layout using Tailwind md:max-w-2xl md:my-4 md:rounded-3xl md:shadow-2xl md:border md:border-slate-200

Header.description: Sticky top bar with z-50 depth, EaseMyTrip blue gradient accent line, back button, location dropdown ('Bengaluru ⌄'), hamburger menu + user avatar, heart saved trips icon with badge, and pencil new chat icon.

OpeningState.description: EaseMyTrip AI introduction banner with greeting, privacy notice pill, and 3 yellow/amber outlined suggestion chips ('Inspire me where to go', 'Build me an itinerary', 'Help me with booking').

ChatStream.description: Scrollable chat message log containing user bubbles, Alfred AI bubbles, destination cards carousel, loading state animation, and itinerary summary cards.

DestinationCarousel.description: Horizontally scrollable flex container with snap-x scrolling showing 2-3 destination cards with tags (Adventure/Culture/Relaxation), price, duration, Save/Share buttons, and 'Select Destination' CTA.

ItinerarySummaryCard.description: Rich card rendered inside the chat showing the compiled trip overview, highlights, day breakdown teaser, and prominent blue 'Open' button.

ItineraryEditorModal.description: Full overlay or bottom sheet editor with day tabs (Day 1, Day 2...), draggable activity stop rows (Breakfast, Places 1-3, Lunch, Dinner), 'Add More Activity', 'Add Day', and 'Book on EaseMyTrip' CTA.

SavedTripsDrawer.description: Side sheet / modal listing saved destination cards with option to view details or generate itinerary.

BottomInputBar.description: Persistent input area at screen bottom with input field, send button, and thumbs up/down AI feedback buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app functions seamlessly in BOTH desktop browser mode (max-w-2xl centered column) and mobile viewport (full-width) via Tailwind break-point utilities (w-full md:max-w-2xl md:mx-auto).
Strictly follow EaseMyTrip branding colors: Primary Blue #005B9B / #004C8F, Caribbean Blue #00A4D5, Accent Orange #FF6B00, with clean white cards and soft slate background #F4F7FA.
Implement hardcoded branching responses in React useState with smooth typing / loading transitions when selecting options or sending custom text.
Make destination cards horizontally scrollable with snap-x scrolling and explicit Save (heart toggle) + Share (copies URL + toast notification) buttons.
Ensure the Itinerary Editor provides day tabs, reorderable activity rows with drag handles or up/down shift, 'Add More Activity' dialog/input, and 'Add Day' functionality.
Include a heart icon in the top header that opens the Saved Trips list with badge counts.
Include a pencil icon in the header that resets the chat session to the greeting state with confirmation toast.
Include a hamburger menu drawer with EaseMyTrip user options (My Bookings, Saved Trips, Settings, Travel Guides).
Include a location dropdown in the header allowing users to select their origin city (Bengaluru, Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai).
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements as specified in the component structure.
